dedupe_keys.name: interaction dataset interactive driving scenarios with semantic maps

description: The INTERACTION dataset (INTERnational, Adversarial and Cooperative moTION) holds vehicle, cyclist and pedestrian trajectories in interactive driving scenarios, recorded by drones and traffic cameras, with semantic maps giving physical layers, reference lines, lanelet connections and traffic rules. It was produced by Wei Zhan, Liting Sun and co-authors from UC Berkeley, FZI and KIT Karlsruhe and MINES ParisTech. Coverage: urban, highway and ramp merging and lane changes, roundabouts with yield or stop signs, signalised intersections and stop-controlled intersections, recorded in several countries on different continents; behaviour ranges from cautious car-following to near-collision manoeuvres and slight real collisions. Format and access: track files per scenario in CSV and maps for loading with the project's Python scripts; access is through the dataset website. Licence and cost: the helper scripts are BSD-3-Clause; the data licence could not be read because the website returned an error on 2026-09-29. Caveats: the recording sites and data volumes are not given in the abstract read. The trajectories support calibration and validation of microscopic traffic and agent-based driver models at conflict points. It relates to the NGSIM and highD trajectory datasets in the catalogue.
